    ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sdlr) AS numeric), 2) as median_sdlr
FROM high_sdlr;

WITH high_sdlr AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(sa.opt_vol, 0) * (1 + ABS(CAST(sa.sentiment_data->>'news_score' AS numeric) - CAST(sa.sentiment_data->>'soc_sent' AS numeric))) * ce.leak_score as sdlr
    FROM trade_records tr
    JOIN corporate_events ce ON tr."REC_KEY" = ce."REC_EVT"
    JOIN market_conditions mc ON ce."REC_EVT" = mc."REC_PIN"
    JOIN sentiment_analytics sa ON sa."REC_SA" = mc."REC_PIN"
    WHERE ce.leak_score > 50.0 
      AND ce.announce_time IN ('Pre-market hrs before', 'Intraday hrs before')
      AND COALESCE(sa.opt_vol, 0) * (1 + ABS(CAST(sa.sentiment_data->>'news_score' AS numeric) - CAST(sa.sentiment_data->>'soc_sent' AS numeric))) * ce.leak_score > 1000
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(sdlr) AS numeric), 2) as avg_sdlr,
    ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sdlr) AS numeric), 2) as median_sdlr
FROM high_sdlr;
